relations: Camera advancing through the tube shifts apparent size and position of the two circular openings and curved walls.
Flowing water on the slide floor moves texture and highlights continuously between the feet and the openings.
Perspective changes and moving reflections alter the dark central divider's apparent shape and position.
The horizontal projection seam persists dividing the dark blue upper region from the illuminated tube below.
caption: A first-person 360-degree view places the camera low on an enclosed water slide, with the rider's feet in black water shoes visible at the bottom center of the frame. Ahead, a smooth tube glows green and cyan, its walls curving around a fork that splits into two circular openings, one bright white on the left and one vivid cyan on the right, separated by a dark central divider. The view shifts gradually through the tube, so the openings change apparent size and position and the curved walls alter their apparent extent over time. Water texture and highlights move across the slide floor between the feet and the openings, shifting continuously. A horizontal projection seam crosses the mid-frame, dividing the dark blue upper region from the illuminated tube below. The dark divider between the openings changes apparent shape and position as perspective shifts and reflections move.
